'''Ro Vacca''' was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] who lived during the last millennia of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Vacca worked as a scribe for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Direus'pei]]. When the Hutt was commissioned by [[Kossak the Younger]] to write a play about [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]], Direus'pei began developing drafts and dictated them to Vacca. They toiled on the project for years and play came to be named [[Evocar (play)|''Evocar'']]. However, Kossak the Younger eventually lost patience and in [[671 BBY]] seized the draft of the play. However, Kossak was horrified by the play, which criticised the Hutt exploitation of the [[Evocii]], so he ordered Direus'pei and all copies of the play to be consumed by [[Maltorran protoplasm]].

Vacca was able to escape with an older draft of the play, and circulated it among the Hutt's [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Species/Legends|species]] per Direus'pei's last wish. As a result, many of the Hutt's client species rose up against their Hutt masters.
